messages:
Marta (Design): Dropped a prototype that adds an "annotation pill" to stack frames + export behavior. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/trace-annotation-proto

Marta (Design): Two quick questions: 1) pill placement (inline vs overlay gutter) for dense traces 2) export semantics — inline in JSON vs separate notes file. Need accessibility and product implications.

Ryan (Design): I prefer overlay gutter to avoid pushing text on long stacks. Icon-only at smaller widths. We should show a short label on hover/focus: "Annotation (hypothesis)".

Sam (Eng): Overlay is fine. Implementation note: keep logical DOM order (frame text then annotation button) so SRs navigate properly. We'll use CSS transform to move the button into the gutter.

Nina (A11y): Important: when a frame receives focus, we should announce any annotation succinctly: e.g. "Annotation: likely nil header. Press Enter to edit." Use aria-live="polite" only for new annotations; otherwise expose via aria-describedby referencing a hidden region.

Alex (Product): For exports we surveyed customers: prefer inline annotations in exported JSON for context, but some infra teams want a separate CSV. Proposal: default inline, add toggle "Export annotations as separate file". Also add helper copy: "Personal annotations excluded by default."

Ben (PM): +1. Also request metadata: author, created_at, visibility. This helps audit and lets support triage.

Sam (Eng): Draft JSON snippet for inline export (v2):
```
{"trace_id":"t-909","frames":[{"id":"f1","function":"parseHeader","annotation":{"text":"likely nil header","author":"marta","ts":"2026-03-20T18:00:00Z","visibility":"team"}}]}
```
We'll keep v1 backward-compatible. Flag: include_personal_annotations=false.

Marta (Design): Copy debate: "Annotation" vs "Hypothesis" vs "Note". Proposal: label primary UI as "Annotation" and inside the editor allow choosing type (hypothesis/observation/action). That keeps the UI neutral.

Nina (A11y): Good. For screen readers, the button aria-label should include function name and type: e.g. aria-label="Annotation (hypothesis) for parseHeader 01: Edit". Also ensure keyboard shortcut 'N' adds an annotation to the focused frame.

Ryan (Design): For dense lists, make pills 20px high icon-only. On hover/focus show full pill. Also ensure high-contrast focus ring for keyboard users.

Sam (Eng): Technical: we'll add an annotations service that stores text + meta and exposes it over the trace API. Exports will call the same service. I'll prototype the API and a small export CLI example.

Alex (Product): Add modal copy for exports: Title: "Export trace" Body checkbox: "Include annotations (visible in trace)" Helper: "Personal annotations excluded by default. Review contents before sharing." CTA: "Export". Add an advanced link: "Export annotations as separate file (CSV/JSON)".

Marta (Design): Action items: Ryan update comp with gutter overlay + compact pill; Sam prototype export_v2 and annotation API; Nina write SR strings and keyboard guide; Alex finalize modal copy; Ben to add metadata requirements to the spec.

deploy-bot: Integration window reminder 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC 1: tag PR #trace-annotations.

Marta (Design): Thanks all. If no objections I'll land the UI label "Annotation (type: hypothesis)" and the default inline export copy by EOD.

Alex (Product): Fine by product. :+1:

Nina (A11y): Will run quick a11y audit once prototype is up.

Sam (Eng): Starting branch today, will ping demo link.
